name: UNSW passivated emitter and rear silicon solar cell (PERC)
description: At the University of New South Wales, a laboratory team demonstrated a silicon solar cell with a passivated emitter and a passivated rear surface with local contacts. The team reported independently confirmed cell conversion efficiency up to 22.8%.

places.note: University of New South Wales, Kensington, Sydney.

date.label: By 25 September 1989
date.basis: The published paper establishes an upper bound on the laboratory result.

events.statement: Andrew W. Blakers, Aihua Wang, Adele M. Milne, Jianhua Zhao and Martin A. Green reported an independently confirmed maximum of 22.8% conversion efficiency for their passivated emitter and rear silicon cell.
events.place_note: Solar Photovoltaic Laboratory, University of New South Wales, Kensington, Australia.
events.scope: Laboratory silicon cell described in Applied Physics Letters 55(13).

evidence.locator: p. 1363, facsimile on the two slides titled First paper PERC solar cell (1989)
evidence.supports: Names the laboratory and authors, describes the cell architecture, and reports independently confirmed conversion efficiency up to 22.8%.
